entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I'm calling about an order I received last month. I need to return a jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Miller, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the Pro-Vent jersey, delivered 36 days ago. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. The material is great, but it's just way too tight across the shoulders.

I understand completely. Getting the perfect fit is key. Since it's a sizing issue and you received the item 36 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process an exchange for a larger size or a full refund for you. Which would you prefer?

That's great news. I'd like to do an exchange. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of repackaging and sending this back, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase?

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While I can't offer a discount code in this situation, I can confirm the return shipping is covered by us and I will process the exchange right away. We'll get the new size sent out to you as soon as the original jersey is scanned by the shipping carrier.
Okay, that's fair. Free return shipping works. An exchange for one size up, a large, would be perfect.
Excellent. I have initiated the exchange for a size large Pro-Vent jersey. You'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid return label and instructions. Does that resolve everything for you today?
Yes, it does. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
